title: Generate implementation plan for retry budget optimization
description: Based on accumulated memory patterns and goal alignment, generate a new implementation phase plan to add a retry budget check to the plan splitting logic. The plan should include: (1) analysis of current retry behavior, (2) design of retry budget constraints, (3) implementation in the plan splitting module, and (4) integration tests.

evidence.evidenceSummary: Memory records show 3 retry-related failures in the past week. Performance observations confirm degraded execution time correlated with retries.

factors: Plan generation may produce large work items
